repositories.name: Babel Truth
repositories.notes: Owns transferable foundations, shared operating rules, semantic contracts, registry, and major architecture decisions. ADR 0004 names the frozen FIRE G7 runtime as the canonical implementation reference for same-role generic Babel shell behavior without creating a universal runtime component dependency.

repositories.name: Babel FIRE
repositories.notes: Owns FIRE production runtime, frozen successor shell, FIRE-specific doctrine/specs/data/tests and FIRE Knowledge. V6 remains production. G7 is 10/10 Locked and Frozen; approved shell runtime anchor is 4a258c5170dd1d96dcbc0f2b0a9c35b283cec489. FIRE Core breadboarding is unblocked and now explicitly observes ADR 0005's cross-app context boundary while remaining independently usable.

repositories.name: Babel Lab
repositories.notes: Lab is evidence, never authority. Experiments remain isolated from production runtime/data. Lab now acts as a reference consumer of the frozen Babel shell for generic UI roles rather than maintaining a parallel generic design system; experiment-specific expression remains local. WORLD Phase 1 remains a bounded Lab audition and does not yet justify a standalone WORLD repository.

repositories.name: Babel World
repositories.notes: WORLD Phase 1 currently lives under babel-lab/world/context-loop/. A real WORLD product earns its own repo only after the bounded orientation/decision slice proves independent value through physical use.
